data.input: Create a script named 'freeze.sh' that creates a file named 'frozen.flag' and prints 'Writes frozen'.

rawInput.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# freeze.sh — simulates freezing writes during migration by creating
# a sentinel file (frozen.flag) and printing a confirmation.

set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
FLAG_FILE="${SCRIPT_DIR}/frozen.flag"

touch "${FLAG_FILE}"

echo "Writes frozen"

rawInput.description: Make freeze.sh executable and test it
